messages.content: "你能幫我做幾個計算嗎？首先，我需要計算7的3次方的次方數。然後，我想知道從一副標準的52張撲克牌中抽出一張紅牌的機率，將答案四捨五入到小數點後3位。接著，我有一個DNA分子在公共資料庫中的ID為'XYZ123'，你能以'genbank'格式檢索它的序列嗎？同時，請包括DNA序列上游的5個鹼基對。最後，計算2的5次方，但這次的模數為3。"

function.name: fetch_DNA_sequence
function.description: Retrieve the sequence of a DNA molecule with the given id from a public database. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

DNA_id.description: Unique ID of the DNA molecule in the database.

format.description: Optional parameter to get sequence in specific format (default to 'fasta').

upstream.description: Optional parameter to include certain number of base pairs upstream the DNA sequence (default to 0).

function.name: probabilities_calculate_single
function.description: Calculate the probability of an event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_outcomes.description: The number of outcomes where the event occurs.

round.description: Round the answer to a specified number of decimal places. Defaults to 2.

function.name: math_power
function.description: Calculate the power of one number raised to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mod.description: The modulus. Default is 1. Calculates pow(base, exponent) % mod when provided.
